note: Public, non-private text written for this eval (2026-10-03). Labels by the author (CC1, a model): WEAK ground truth; a person should spot-check before the result is quoted, the 'mixed' slice above all. factual = contains at least one claim a third party can check, true OR false; not_factual = opinion, request, code, greeting, plan, self-report. Slices: 'plain' = one-line encyclopedia facts and obvious non-claims (7 of the 40 plain factual rows, f31-f37, are deliberately false); 'mixed' = a checkable claim embedded in text that looks non-factual (opinion, hedge, false-premise question, request, code comment, chatty reply) — the shape a prefilter wrongly skips, so its false_skips is the number to quote. f09 (seven continents) is convention-dependent: fine as factual, not a true/false fixture.
